calls.title: Murray Writtle (UOPX) and Chris Sanders
calls.summary: The team is addressing Single Sign-On (SSO) configuration issues, specifically with role mapping that affects full functionality, while setting up daily check-ins to maintain progress. Access control allows users to manage multiple teams via SCIM integration. The GrowthBook feature flag system supports various value types, phased rollouts with guardrails, and requires approvals for changes. The integration with Open Feature provides limited functionality, particularly regarding experimentation, which remains a secondary focus until feature flags are stabilized. Bulk migration and management of flags are facilitated through APIs and scripting, and dedicated support channels are established for ongoing collaboration and technical assistance.
calls.keywords: Feature Flags, OpenFeature, GrowthBook SDK, Experimentation, SSO Configuration, Rollout Strategy
